Engine, assets + technology

As a team we have chosen to use unity as the main engine for our game because of our knowledge in C#. We are also going to be using Unity Hub and Package manager. We chose this because based on the lesson videos we saw, we learned a few things about characters and how to create a functioning game, so we have information to get started. Additionally, it is also because we felt that it would be easiest to work with.
